report.summary: Verified claims against progress_sources.py. 4 CONFIRMED (rollback-applied logic, numeric confusion, heartbeat thread safety, exception swallowing), 1 UNDECIDABLE (missing functions). Todos require clarifying intent vs id in snapshot_from_ledger, auditing offload.py for dirty_unreverted, verifying heartbeat thread safety, and logging in watch_stream.
risks: CONFIRMED record_offload_result: when rolled_back is true but dirty_unreverted key missing, applied becomes False (line ~95: applied = bool(result.get('dirty_unreverted')) with bool(None) → False). This is by design to be conservative, but may underreport dirty files.

CONFIRMED snapshot_from_ledger: numeric string confusion. Passing effect_key='123' first tries ledger.get(123) by id, potentially returning wrong intent or None before falling back to resolve_by_effect (lines ~165-172).
CONFIRMED track_call: heartbeat thread writes to P.heartbeat (line ~140) without explicit lock or thread-safety guarantee for the progress log, creating risk of concurrent writes.
UNDECIDABLE Audit limited: snapshot_from_bridge and snapshot_any are not visible in the provided slice of progress_sources.py; would need the complete file to verify their behavior.
CONFIRMED watch_stream: exception swallowing hides all progress recording failures (bare except: pass, line ~79); no recovery or fallback logging.
todos: Fix snapshot_from_ledger: disambiguate effect key vs id (e.g., try effect string first, then fallback to int id if input is numeric and not matched).
Audit offload.py to ensure dirty_unreverted always present when rolled_back; or handle missing key as error in record_offload_result.
Verify P.heartbeat thread safety in daedalus/progress.py; if not, document and protect with lock in the heartbeat thread.
Add logging in watch_stream for caught exceptions (e.g., stderr or dedicated error log) to aid diagnostics.
